{{Youmay|the handheld scanner|for the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] the [[Weapons detection system]]}}
[[File:WeaponDetector-DC.png|thumb|right|250px|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi being checked for weapons at [[Hondo's complex/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate outpost]]]]
The '''weapon detector''', '''weapon-detector''',<ref name="RoB">{{WEGCite|story=Raid on Brentaal|book=The Far Orbit Project}} {{ID|weapon-detector}}</ref> or '''weapon scanner''' was a type of [[Security scanner/Legends|security scanner]]. The devices scanned for key indicators that pointed towards the presence of hidden weapons including metals, composite [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramics]], [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]], and [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] residue.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

A [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] device designed to detect [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] and other commonly used weapon profiles, the data was then transmitted to a dedicated [[Computer/Legends|computer]] for virtually instant analysis. Weapons detectors could detect the vast majority of weapons, although some weapons, usually carried by professional [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], and [[Spy/Legends|spies]], were capable of evading standard weapons scans.

Weapon detectors were used in a broad range of locations with restricted access, such as military bases, spaceports, prisons, detention centers and other restricted areas. Their purpose was to prevent unauthorized weapons being brought into secured areas. The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] used many weapon detectors to maintain order on various worlds, such as [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]].
